description: When asked to post Obsidian draft notes to Slack #content, agent reported no Slack MCP was available and fell back to pasting formatted content in chat. The master-slack skill exists for exactly this purpose and should have been read and invoked instead of searching for a Slack MCP connector.
correction: When David says 'post to Slack', always read and invoke skills/master-slack/SKILL.md first. Do not search for a Slack MCP connector as the primary path. The master-slack skill is the authorized path for all Slack posts.
